generator_notes:
Harlow Bros runs Magento 2 with the Amasty xsearch extension. The recorder did not navigate to a search-results page (final_url stayed on the homepage), so the only candidate carrying products was the autocomplete XHR at /amasty_xsearch/autocomplete/index/?q=... — this was the same endpoint across all three queries. The response body is JSON of the form {"10": {"type": "product", "html": "..."}, "30": {"type": "category", ...}, "behavior": ...}, where block 10 contains a list of
  • cards that include the product-item-link with title/href, an SKU span, a price-wrapper span, and a product-image-photo . The adapter parses these out with regular expressions and projects them to {title, url, sku, price, image_url, product_id}. Method is browser_required because the xsearch endpoint refuses synthesized HTTP requests with HTTP 403 — even a same-origin page.evaluate(fetch) call from a primed browser context. The endpoint is gated by per-session form_key + uenc query params plus cookie state that the Amasty xsearch JS attaches at typing time; the recorder captured a successful request because it was fired by the page itself in response to the user typing in the search input. The adapter therefore replays that interaction: launch headless Chromium, navigate to the homepage, locate the search input (input.amsearch-input, input#search, or input[name=q] in fall-back order), call page.fill() with the query, and use page.waitForResponse to capture the autocomplete JSON. dom_selector records the xsearch HTML card boundary for documentation; parsing happens via regex inside the captured JSON, not via page.$$eval. The captured request carried sec-ch-ua-*, referer, user-agent and x-requested-with headers; the browser sets these naturally at runtime. Stripped from the recording's headers: form_key URL parameter (handled by the page's own JS), sec-ch-ua, sec-ch-ua-platform, sec-ch-ua-mobile, referer (browser-managed).
